ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-3,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-E in
the area bound by:

A line 200 feet north of and parallel to East 112" Street; a public alley next east of and
parallel to South Michigan Avenue; a line 150 feet north of and parallel to East 112"
Street; South Michigan Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Ai CL. Baale

Anthony A. Beale
Alderman, 9‘ Ward

Common Address:
11139 S. Michigan Avenue
